#Artaeum

Off the coast of Summerset lies the isle of Artaeum, home of the Psijic Order, the oldest school of magic in Tamriel. Some years it is there. Some years it is not.

The Order removes the island from the world when it does not wish to be disturbed. It has not wished to be disturbed for most of recorded history.

#The Old Way

The Psijics practice what they call the Old Way: magic as a kind of patience. They do not teach spells so much as ways of seeing.

Those who have studied with them come back changed. They speak less. They look at the sea as if it might, at any moment, have an island in it.
